ائتمرت (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَرْتُ (iʔtamartu) /iʔ.ta.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمَرْتَ (iʔtamarta) /iʔ.ta.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمَرْتِ (iʔtamarti) /iʔ.ta.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمَرَتْ (iʔtamarat) /iʔ.ta.ma.rat/: third-perso
